notes: GIF assets are converted to temporary MP4 with ffmpeg before upload.
This media judge is evidence-quality QA; it does not replace backend/browser production gates.

asset.title: Notebook Agent Lane
asset.purpose: README live walkthrough clip. Judge whether the feature is obvious, visually consistent, and credible as evidence.

judge.summary: The walkthrough clearly demonstrates the Notebook Agent Lane feature, showing a user prompting an agent to summarize meeting notes, which then populates the Capture Notebook with structured decisions and risks.

featureClarity.evidence: The video clearly shows the transition from an empty notebook to an agent-populated structured note via a chat command.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Captures the entire flow: opening the notebook, entering the prompt, and seeing the real-time generation of structured content.

visualDesign.evidence: Clean dark-mode interface with distinct panels, though the high density of information can feel slightly crowded.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the NodeRoom paradigm of combining chat, notebooks, and agent traces.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Shows authentic UI interactions, typing states, and live document updates without artificial edits.

legibility.evidence: Most text is highly legible, though some smaller metadata chips and sidebar labels require close attention.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant for knowledge workers and teams looking to automate meeting synthesis and risk tracking.

productionHonesty.evidence: The generation speed and UI response times reflect realistic system performance.

defects.observed: The contrast of the placeholder text in the chat input box is slightly low against the dark background.
defects.fix: Increase the contrast of the input placeholder text for better accessibility.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch how the NodeRoom Agent automatically synthesizes meeting notes into structured decisions and risks directly inside your shared Capture Notebook.
